description: Use for current events, monitoring a company/person/topic in the press, finding recent coverage before answering, or building news digests. Returns up to 20 articles with title, direct article url (no redirect wrapper), publisher, published time (ISO 8601), snippet and image when available. sort=date for newest first; freshness=hour|day|week|month to limit age; market for regional editions (en-US, en-GB, de-DE, …). Primary source is Bing News public RSS (retried automatically when Bing answers an empty page), fallback Brave Search News; the response names the source used. Empty results = 404, not charged. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

market.description: Market/locale as language-COUNTRY, e.g. en-US, en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP (applied on the Bing source).

page.description: Result page (1-5); each page is "count" results.

q.description: News query (max 400 chars), e.g. a company, person, topic; site:reuters.com works on Bing.
